title: Sheaf of derived local isomorphisms and canonical local coefficient transport
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $B$ a commutative ring in universe $u+1$, and $A,K\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For an etale object $V\to X$, let $L_V$ be the exact derived inverse image to $D(V_{\mathrm{et}},B)$, identified with the localized etale site. Define the presheaf $\mathcal P(A,K)$ by $\mathcal P(A,K)(V)=\operatorname{Iso}(L_VA,L_VK)$. For $f:V\to W$, restriction sends $e$ to $\alpha_{f,A}\circ f^*(e)\circ\alpha_{f,K}^{-1}$ in application order, where $\alpha_f:L_V\simeq L_Wf^*$ is the canonical composition comparison localized from the existing etale inverse-image functors. These restriction maps obey the identity and composition laws. Define $\mathcal I(A,K)=\mathcal P(A,K)^\#$ using the canonical sheafification functor [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. For a scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$, let $L_{f,R}=\nu_X^*|_{Y_{\mathrm{proet}}}$ on derived fixed-$R$ sheaves, the composite of the canonical exact comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $q:R\to S$ define $U_{X,q}L_{f,R}\simeq L_{f,S}U_{Y,q}$ by localizing and composing the canonical coefficient mates [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows] for comparison and pro-etale inverse image. For a specified arrow $d:A\to U_{X,q}K$, its pulled normalization arrow is $L_{f,R}(d)$ followed by the component at $K$ of this canonical interchange. These constructions impose no boundedness, finiteness, or arbitrary choice of comparison map.
